title: Hertz contact: surface deflection field vs the exact half-space solution

criteria.reference: Hertz 1882 J. reine angew. Math. 92:156; Johnson 1985 Contact Mechanics Sec. 4.2 DOI:10.1017/cbo9781139171731; Boussinesq 1885 (point load kernel)
criteria.pool_mandate: <3% on contact radius a and indentation delta, load P prescribed

gates.quantity: |w(0)/delta - 1| of the exact half-space oracle (no FEM)
gates.reference: Hertz relation w(0) = pi p0 a/(2 E*) = a^2/R = delta

gates.quantity: max |w(r) - (delta - r^2/2R)|/delta of the oracle for r/a < 1
gates.reference: the indenter is a paraboloid: the exact solution is flat inside contact
Boussinesq point-load asymptote of the same Hertz pressure

gates.quantity: max |D_fe - D_exact| / delta over r/a in [1.1, 3], h/a=0.015, depth 96a
gates.reference: exact half-space deflection under the Hertz pressure; D = w(r)-w(0)
gates.note: offset invariant: the fixed base of the truncated body leaves an arbitrary rigid constant in the raw nodal u_z

gates.quantity: max |D_fe - D_exact| / |D_exact| over the same radii
gates.reference: same, normalised by the local deflection

gates.quantity: |max shape error (h/a=fine) - max shape error (h/a=coarse)| (pct points)
gates.reference: a field metric that is real should not move under refinement by 2
the raw constant is truncation: it must move when the boundary moves
gates.note: the offset is discarded by the field metric, so the field verdict does not depend on it

gates.quantity: max penetration / delta of the finest mesh
gates.reference: ALM complementarity: the indenter must not penetrate

gates.quantity: max |D_fe - D_exact(p_fe)| / delta over the observation radii, where p_fe is the traction the FE solution itself recovered
gates.reference: exact half-space response to the FE traction (same Boussinesq kernel)
gates.note: loose consistency bound on the (pressure recovery + elastic operator) pair; see the diagnostics block for what this does NOT show

gates.quantity: max shape error (pct of delta) of the same metric evaluated against a wrong competing Hertz state with a 10% larger contact radius
gates.reference: same load, a' = 1.1a, p0' = p0/1.21, delta' = 1.21 delta
gates.note: non-vacuity control: a tolerance the metric cannot enforce is worthless

gates.quantity: |indentation error here - indentation error of the certified load-control anchor| (pct points), same mesh and load
gates.note: replication check: this driver must reproduce the certified number

limitations: frictionless, adhesion-free, small-strain, linear elastic: a verification of the elastic half-space operator only (p0 = 3.5e3 is far above any real yield strength in the dimensionless units used here)

the model is the exact Hertz equivalent (rigid paraboloid on a half-space with E* = E/(1-nu^2)); a two-deformable-body contact algorithm is not exercised, which is exactly the assumption the reduction rests on
the deflection profile is compared only for r/a <= 3; the far field of the truncated domain is dominated by the boundary condition
the graded quantities are offset invariant; the absolute nodal u_z of the truncated body carries a 1% rigid constant that this certificate does not claim to resolve
